issue.title: Post-script should submit formal COMMENT review when it minimizes a prior APPROVED review in the same run

llm_context.input_title: Post-script should submit formal COMMENT review when it minimizes a prior APPROVED review in the same run
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: The post-review script/harness incorrectly skips submitting a formal COMMENT review when a prior APPROVED review is minimized in the same run, leaving the pull request with zero visible formal reviews.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The skip-COMMENT optimization condition checks whether a sticky comment was updated but fails to verify whether any prior formal review was minimized during the same run, causing the PR review state to transition from approved to zero visible reviews.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect HarnessRouter.routeComment Control Flow
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol HarnessRouter.routeComment in internal/dispatch/router.go to understand the skip-COMMENT optimization logic when prior reviews are minimized.

step_by_step_plan.title: Update Skip-COMMENT Condition
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the condition in internal/dispatch/router.go to ensure that if a prior formal review is minimized during the run, the script bypasses the skip-COMMENT optimization and submits a formal COMMENT review.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add Regression Test in router_test.go
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a new unit test in internal/dispatch/router_test.go validating that a comment verdict accompanied by a minimized prior formal review successfully submits a formal COMMENT review.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Run the test suite using go test ./internal/dispatch/... to verify the fix and ensure no regressions are introduced.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: GitHub allows multiple reviews on a pull request, but older reviews can be minimized or marked as outdated when new reviews are submitted.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Developers and automated systems rely on visible review badges (Approved, Changes Requested, Commented) to determine whether a pull request is ready to merge.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: When an older APPROVED review is minimized and no new formal COMMENT review is posted because of incorrect skip logic, the PR ends up with zero visible reviews.

structured_concepts.concept_name: Conditional Execution Flags in Automation Scripts
structured_concepts.short_explanation: Boolean optimization flags that bypass certain steps if other states are satisfied.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Incorrectly scoped bypass conditions can inadvertently skip critical side-effects under edge-case combinations of states.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The skip-COMMENT optimization logic assumes that updating a sticky comment replaces the need for a formal review, failing to account for concurrent review minimization.

common_pitfalls: Assuming that minimizing a review automatically counts as submitting a new visible review state.
Applying the skip-COMMENT optimization globally without checking whether any prior formal reviews were hidden or minimized in the same execution run.
